headline: Kushtia: Jamaat insists on Zila School ground despite stadium rally permit
summary: District administration grants permission for an 11-party unity rally at Shaheed Abbrar Fahad Stadium, but Jamaat-e-Islami remains firm on holding their event at the Zila School ground as previously announced.
details: The district administration has granted permission for the closing rally of the 11-party unity Dhaka-Khulna-Kushtia long march to be held at the Shaheed Abbrar Fahad Stadium in Kushtia. However, Jamaat-e-Islami has stated that they will proceed with their rally at the Zila School ground as per their prior announcement.

An official permission letter, signed by Assistant Commissioner Zakiul Alam of the Deputy Commissioner's office, was issued on Monday evening. The permit includes eight conditions, such as prohibiting activities that could deteriorate law and order, discussions that hurt religious sentiments, and provocative speeches. It also states that no other venue can be used and the organizers will be held responsible for any disorder.

Following the news of the stadium permit, Jamaat's Kushtia district secretary Enamul Haque issued a statement late Monday night, asserting their commitment to holding the rally at the Zila School ground on October 31 as planned. Jamaat claims they had initially applied for the stadium on October 13, but the Deputy Commissioner cited various reasons for denying permission and suggested an alternative venue.

Jamaat then selected the Zila School ground as their alternative. The president of the Zila School committee applied for the ground on October 18. According to Jamaat, they began preparations based on verbal approval from the Deputy Commissioner and the Khulna Divisional Commissioner. Promotional activities, including banners, posters, and billboards, are nearly complete.

Jamaat alleges that the Deputy Commissioner is creating new complications by bringing up the stadium issue just five days before the rally. The party expresses deep concern over the timing of this development, given their extensive preparations. Enamul Haque has appealed to the administration, authorities, and the public for cooperation in making the event successful.
In their statement, the district Jamaat urged party members, supporters, and the general public to exercise patience, discipline, and responsibility, advising against responding to any provocations.

headline: 5 killed as lorry rams into passengers beside Dhaka-Chattogram highway
summary: Three members of the same family were among the deceased after a speeding lorry hit people waiting by the roadside in Sitakunda.
details: At least five people were killed and eight others injured when a speeding lorry ploughed into passengers standing beside the Dhaka–Chittagong highway in Sitakunda early today.
The victims were waiting by the roadside after their Dhaka-bound passenger bus developed a mechanical fault and pulled over around 1:00 am.
The accident occurred around 1:10 am in the Chhota Kumira Royal Cement Gate area of Sitakunda upazila in Chattogram.
According to Sitakunda Police Station OC Mohinul Islam, three people died on the spot, while two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).
One of the deceased has been identified as eight-year-old Rakib; the identities of the others are yet to be confirmed.
The injured have been admitted to different wards of CMCH, with several of them reported to be in critical condition.
caption:

According to Sitakunda Police Station OC Mohinul Islam, three people died on the spot, while two others passed away after being taken to Chattogram Medical College Hospital (CMCH).

One of the deceased has been identified as eight-year-old Rakib; the identities of the others are yet to be confirmed.
